proposed_answer: Release 1 includes ACH debit intake (with UNB-XIN-PAY-001/002/005), wires, checks and DTC securities; domestic grants to IRS-listed public charities and to catalogued domestic intermediaries. Excluded: card intake, direct foreign grants (ED/ER), call recording, distribution partners, white-label, embedded checkout, partner-exit tooling. Pooled investment options are included only if securities counsel's opinion is on file at launch; otherwise a cash sweep only.
effect: Removes from release 1 the P0s for card disputes, foreign ED, OFAC general licences and partner funds-flow; keeps ACH-debit P0s.

proposed_answer: High-volume-low-balance is not a release-1 model. Revisit when metered cost-to-serve exists (UNB-XIN-SAS-009, UNB-XIN-ECO-004) and a fee floor passes the XID-ECO-002 rule.
effect: UNB-XIN-ADV-001 deferred; minimum-fee shortfall waivers (UNB-XIN-ERP-001) remain as a control.

proposed_answer: Release-1 economics = non-posting attribution with grades (ECO-001..004), the six-metric catalog (ECO-007), per-call AI metering (ECO-009), December capacity forecast (ECO-017), scoped views (ECO-021) and the monthly pack only (ECO-022 cut down). Six metrics: cost per settled grant by rail; cost per settled contribution by rail; cost per account-month by balance band; cost per resolved case; cost per exception by type; AI cost per run — each with its counter-metric. Everything else after measurement exists; simulation stays in Echelon offline.
effect: Economics requirements in R1 fall from 22 to 10.

proposed_answer: Not needed in release 1: Unbound is book of record for every function of the single sponsor. Keep UNB-XIN-ADV-002 for the first institutional sponsor.

Adopt the recommendation: any one advisor may recommend grants below a sponsor threshold (default $25,000, illustrative); all advisors required for larger grants, transfers out, closure, successor and authority changes; simultaneous conflicting instructions are held (UNB-XIN-EVA-012).

AAL2 with any authenticator for grant recommendations; phishing-resistant authenticators for payee, contact-method and authority changes and for all workforce users. Partner-IdP step-up is moot in R1 (no partners).
effect: Reduces donor friction found in XIF-ADV-018.

proposed_answer: Yes: the platform maintains reviewed default packs (rail obligations, unclaimed-property table, decline reasons, contact assurance matrix, recognition point, discretionary policy); the release-1 sponsor adopts them by attestation and may only tighten them.
Authenticator bindings are authority facts owned by IAM; changing one needs step-up on an existing factor and notice to the prior channel.
